digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM Bedrock provider and capability layer
propositions: rebar has no native Bedrock path; this story adds a first-class native Bedrock provider builder constructing pydantic-ai's BedrockConverseModel/BedrockProvider via the ambient AWS credential chain, rather than fronting Bedrock with an OpenAI-compatible gateway.
Bedrock prompt caching must set exactly two keys (bedrock_cache_instructions and bedrock_cache_tool_definitions) for parity with the Anthropic path, and must NOT set bedrock_cache_messages.

Bedrock prompt caching is model-dependent and fails silently (cache_read=0 and cache_write=0 while billing full input tokens), so rebar must WARN when caching was requested but both cache counters are zero with input_tokens>0, using a separate helper from _warn_if_zeroed_usage.

temperature is fatal (400 ValidationException) on some Bedrock models like us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7, so a supports_temperature capability plus an exact-id override table (_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES) must let runner.py omit temperature for affected models while retaining it for the measured-good default.

A provider-agnostic failure translator must convert a 400/ValidationException naming a sampling parameter and a rejection word into an LLMConfigError naming the model id, parameter, and remedies, keyed on error content not provider name.

boto3 must ship as a [bedrock] optional extra (also added to dev) so [agents] installs remain AWS-free while unit tests run in CI, and the live cache canary must live under tests/external/ excluded from default CI selection.
